steps.title: Welcome to Graphdule
steps.description: Projects are graphs of evolving understanding. Decompose long-term goals into concrete tasks connected by explicit dependency arrows leading to a single End Goal.

steps.title: Graph, Cascade & Timeline
steps.description: Visualize workflows left-to-right. Move tasks and let the intelligent cascade engine preview downstream date shifts before applying them. Switch to Timeline for temporal Gantt projections.
highlights: Interactive left-to-right DAG with status colors
Topological cascade shifts and impact preview
Derived spans and detailed task notes drawer

steps.title: My Day Execution & Recurrence
steps.description: Focus on what matters today. Combine active project tasks with standalone recurring work (daily, weekly, monthly) and toggle between 'Today' and 'Current Active' tasks.
highlights: Daily execution surface with quick completion
Toggle between Today and all Current tasks

steps.title: Cloud Sync & Google Calendar
steps.description: Seamlessly backup and synchronize your database across devices with Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive. Sync deadlines two-way with Google Calendar so your schedule is always with you.
highlights: Direct Google Drive & OneDrive cloud integration
Live status badge and cross-device conflict resolution

steps.title: Local-First & Installable PWA
steps.description: Your data stays 100% private and stored locally in browser IndexedDB with zero cloud lock-in. Export canonical JSON anytime, and install Graphdule as a native PWA on Desktop, iOS, or Android.
highlights: Install as standalone app on mobile & desktop

steps.title: Version History & Ready to Go!
steps.description: Capture immutable snapshots over time, compare changes, and restore past working states safely. You're ready to start building your projects!
highlights: Immutable version snapshots with visual diffs
Rich markdown notes and dark/light themes
